283:t_013:0.en:
$$ミレイナ$$
「Analysis of the unknowns' assimilation attacks is complete!」

283:t_013:1.en:
$$フェルト$$
「As suspected, their attacks seem intended to assimilate or fuse with their targets!」

283:t_013:2.en:
$$フェルト$$
「A hit seems to damage not just the machine, but also shock the pilot's mind and brain!」

283:t_013:3.en:
$$フェルト$$
「If pilots lose consciousness, they cannot resist the unknowns' assimilation!」

283:t_013:4.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Then we'd be helpless. Once pilots take a certain amount of damage, we'll have to pull them back.」

283:t_013:5.en:
$$シン$$
「What the hell are those things!?」

283:t_013:6.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「...There are no pilots inside them...」

283:t_013:9.en:
$$バナージ$$
「No, that isn't it...! They're...」

283:t_013:12.en:
$$キラ$$
「I can't believe creatures like that exist...!」

283:t_013:13.en:
$$レド$$
「Alien life that attacks humanity and cannot be communicated with...」

283:t_013:15.en:
$$スメラギ$$
(I don't understand... Why would this $$バアル$$ target the $$ソレスタルビーイング$$ base...?)

283:t_013:16.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「How are we supposed to fight something like this!?」

283:t_013:17.en:
$$赤木$$
「But this is bad! At this rate, the base...!」

283:t_013:18.en:
$$ミレイナ$$
「$$ノリエガ$$! Something's coming out of the base's dock!」

283:t_014:1.en:
$$バナージ$$
「You've completed the $$ダブルオークアンタ$$!」

283:t_014:2.en:
$$刹那$$
「Sorry to keep you waiting, $$バナージ$$.」

283:t_014:3.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「It's not perfect yet, but it's at least more complete than it was during the $$時獄戦役$$.」

283:t_014:4.en:
$$イアン$$
「We're counting on you, $$刹那$$! A lot of $$イノベイド$$s helped tune that machine!」

283:t_014:5.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「Let's do this for them at the base too, $$刹那$$.」

283:t_014:8.en:
$$刹那$$
「I can't... put it into words...」

283:t_014:9.en:
$$カミーユ$$
($$刹那$$ senses it too...)

283:t_014:10.en:
$$アムロ$$
(That strange feeling about the unknowns...)

283:t_014:11.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「All units, reform your formation around the $$クアンタ$$!」

283:t_014:12.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「To avoid assimilation, I'll order any pilot whose mental condition becomes critical to withdraw!」

283:t_014:15.en:
$$刹那$$
($$クアンタ$$... Our battle begins now...)

283:t_015:1.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「A new enemy... Are they $$バアル$$ too...?」

283:t_015:3.en:
$$バナージ$$
「The $$ダブルオークアンタ$$ is amazing.」

283:t_015:4.en:
$$シン$$
「And it's still not finished... How much stronger will it get?」

283:t_015:5.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「The $$クアンタ$$ still cannot fully channel the $$ツインドライヴ$$'s $$ＧＮ粒子$$ into its weapons.」

283:t_015:6.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「But completing the $$クアンタ$$ involves more than its combat power.」

283:t_015:8.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「You'll understand when the time comes. And we'll need $$刹那$$'s power as an $$イノベイター$$ for that.」

283:t_015:9.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「A machine that fully harnesses an $$イノベイター$$'s abilities...」

283:t_015:10.en:
$$アムロ$$
(So its concept is the same as the $$ユニコーン$$'s full $$サイコ・フレーム$$...)

283:t_015:11.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「First, we'll compile what we know about the unknowns. All units, return to base.」

283:t_016:0.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「All right! Both I and the $$サバーニャ$$ are in top form!」

283:t_016:1.en:
$$ハロ$$
「Good job, $$ロックオン$$. Good job, $$ロックオン$$.」

283:t_016:2.en:
$$青ハロ$$
「$$ロックオン$$, ladies' man. $$ロックオン$$, ladies' man.」

283:t_016:3.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「You remembered what $$赤木$$ said...」

283:t_016:4.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「I don't know about being a ladies' man, but she's in that base! I won't let you lay a finger on her!」

283:t_017:2.en:
$$ラッセ$$
「Damn it! We couldn't protect the base!」

283:t_017:3.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Now, even if we defeat the enemy...」

283:t_100:0.en:
$$ノノ$$
(Why is it...? I can tell these $$宇宙怪獣$$ really are different from the ones we fought at the galactic center...)

283:t_100:1.en:
$$ノノ$$
(What is it...? My chest feels uneasy...)

283:t_101:1.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Our $$バスターマシン$$s will take on both you and the $$宇宙怪獣$$ at the galactic center!」

283:t_102:0.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「So these are a parallel world's $$宇宙怪獣$$...」

283:t_102:1.en:
$$ノリコ$$
(What's going on...? This world has the same $$宇宙怪獣$$ as my world, but...)

283:t_102:2.en:
$$ノリコ$$
(If $$宇宙怪獣$$ exist across parallel worlds, what are these in front of me...?)

283:t_103:0.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「I sense something from the unknown in front of me...」

283:t_103:1.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「I don't understand... Is this hostility... or some other feeling...?」

283:t_104:0.en:
$$バナージ$$
(What is this...!? It's like an enormous number of people are screaming at once...!)

283:t_104:1.en:
$$バナージ$$
(Is this... the unknown's will...?)

283:t_105:0.en:
$$アムロ$$
(The unknown's will... What is this...?)

283:t_105:1.en:
$$アムロ$$
(I don't understand... Is this a creature with a completely different way of thinking from ours...?)

283:t_106:0.en:
$$シャア$$
「Tch...! They seem to have some purpose, but I can't grasp it...!」

283:t_106:1.en:
$$シャア$$
「Since they're harming us, do we have no choice but to fight back...!?」

283:t_107:1.en:
$$フォウ$$
「You sensed it too, $$クェス$$.」

283:t_107:2.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「Why...? Why can we tell this thing has a will...?」

283:t_107:3.en:
$$クェス$$
「How should I know!? These things are attacking us!」

283:t_107:4.en:
$$フォウ$$
「We have to fight now, rather than question what they are...!」
